title: Polynomials with prescribed evaluations
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $s,t$ be finite sets of indices, and let $v,w$ assign elements of $F$ to each index. Suppose $v$ is injective on $s$ and $t\subseteq s$. Then the polynomials over $F$ of degree less than $|s|$ whose values at $v(i)$ equal $w(i)$ for every $i\in t$ are in bijection with the functions from $s\setminus t$ to $F$.
